title: Yuan-Ti Scale Mail
summary: AC 15 plus full Dexterity, +1 Initiative and no Stealth penalty.

fields.Armour Class: 15 plus full Dexterity modifier. Medium Armour proficiency. No imposed Disadvantage on Stealth.
fields.Exotic Material: The full Dexterity bonus stops working if you take Medium Armour Master or Magic Initiate: Cleric. The source reports those feats cap the Dexterity contribution at +3.
fields.Acquisition: Quartermaster Talli near the Last Light Inn waypoint (−31, 130).

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
